name: Lattice
description: Performance management doesn't happen just in performance management software. It happens in meetings, feedback, goals, updates, and increasingly in the AI tool you open before your email. Lattice MCP connects that context into Claude so employees can submit updates, managers can draft stronger reviews, and prepare for people conversations without leaving the conversation. It brings Lattice data into the flow of work, grounded in the same permissions customers already trust.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lattice to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lattice to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.latticehq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lattice MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lattice lists 20 MCP tools, including whoami, find-employees, find-reports, find-ancestors, list-departments, get-draft-reviews, submit-review, find-reviews, get-review-cycles, get-review-context-for-reviewee, get-review-packet-for-reviewee, and save-draft-review.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lattice?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lattice in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Lattice requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lattice is developed by Lattice. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
